plan.summary: Cache size can now be set with the `CACHE_MB` environment variable. `cacheConfig` reads it and uses it only when it is a finite number above zero. Otherwise it uses `DEFAULT_MEGABYTES`.
plan.riskRationale: One small change in one function. Invalid values fall back to the old default. No tests appear in the diff.
plan.storyArc: One change: `cacheConfig` takes its cache size from `CACHE_MB` and keeps the default for missing or invalid input.

topics.title: Read cache size from CACHE_MB with a safe fallback
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `cacheConfig` choose the cache size now? Explain the parse of `env.CACHE_MB` and the check that returns the default for unset, non-numeric, zero, or negative values. Verify how `Number` treats an unset or empty value.
